The main takeaway from our work is that
non-contact interactions are crucial in order to understand the light-by-light contribution.
a consistent inclusion of the transverse parts in the quark-phonon vertex is mandatory to get a reliable estimate for the hadronic light by-light scattering contribution.
non-perturbative effects are crucial for a quantitative description of hadronic light-by light scattering.
